command:
sh -c '
set -eu
state=/tmp/rtctrl-rng-network-20261004
test -d "$state"
test ! -e "$state/server.pid"
test ! -e "$state/transfer.bin"
printf "%s  %s\n" b713e277bfcd25384975acb31253254b93bdad4a70e529b403368f6dbb4dc6f6 /bin/network-helper | sha256sum -c -
/bin/network-helper serve "$state/transfer.bin" > "$state/server.log" 2>&1 &
printf "%s\n" "$!" > "$state/server.pid"
sleep 1
cat "$state/server.log"
'
